baseline_oracle.note: The first progress state predates rosbag capture. It is recovered from the recorded Float32 remaining-distance value. A companion pairing probe bounded alternate bag-only startup reconstruction at 0.281 mm / 20.8 urad; the explicit 1 mm / 50 urad geometry bounds conservatively cover that missing state. This report records its seeded replay maxima directly. Scalar/time equality is evaluated separately after the documented stationary startup prefix.

startup_context_missing.reason: route-manager state already existed before rosbag capture; the initial stationary prefix cannot reproduce scalar/time payload exactly from recorded topics

active_snapshot_population.requirement: at least one active snapshot and no unexplained active exclusions

actual.pairing_method: same ROS header stamp, then first unused causal bag record; timer stop refresh outputs remain unused

all_raw_trajectories_paired.requirement: every selected raw trajectory has one same-stamp callback result

actual.note: The first progress state predates rosbag capture. It is recovered from the recorded Float32 remaining-distance value. A companion pairing probe bounded alternate bag-only startup reconstruction at 0.281 mm / 20.8 urad; the explicit 1 mm / 50 urad geometry bounds conservatively cover that missing state. This report records its seeded replay maxima directly. Scalar/time equality is evaluated separately after the documented stationary startup prefix.

startup_context_missing.reason: route-manager state already existed before rosbag capture; the initial stationary prefix cannot reproduce scalar/time payload exactly from recorded topics

baseline_strength10_oracle.requirement: strength-10 geometry matches all active trajectories and scalar/time is exact after the documented startup prefix

candidate_curvature_material_reduction.requirement: candidate moving-midroute curvature p95 <= 80% of baseline

candidate_curvature_max_supports_15mps.requirement: moving-midroute maximum adjacent-point trajectory peak curvature <= 0.004444444 1/m

candidate_endpoint_yaw_delta.requirement: candidate endpoint tangent/yaw differs from v4 by <= 0.02 rad

candidate_fixed_stop_anchors.requirement: every in-horizon goal stop anchor moves by <= 1e-8 m

candidate_hard_deviation_guard.requirement: all applied smoothing deviations are <= configured 0.10 m guard

candidate_hard_stop_location_delta.requirement: first hard-stop sentinel location changes by <= 0.05 m

candidate_midroute_4_to_9mps_caps.requirement: zero 4-9 m/s horizon caps after 5 m progress and before terminal braking

candidate_no_peak_curvature_regression.requirement: candidate maximum curvature does not exceed baseline

candidate_no_smoothing_rejection.requirement: strength-10000 produces zero guarded rejection/fail-open snapshots

candidate_route_corridor.requirement: every candidate point remains inside the 0.20 m production corridor

candidate_selection_deviation_envelope.requirement: maximum strength-10 to strength-10000 XY deviation stays within 0.05 m

candidate_solve_latency.requirement: single-thread solve p95 <= 20 ms and maximum <= 50 ms

candidate_valid_geometry.requirement: no self intersections and every segment is longer than 1e-4 m

limitations: The frozen vehicle motion remains the v4 motion; this is not a live closed-loop replay.
The candidate is prohibited on turns and on every route containing commands other than STRAIGHT/LANEFOLLOW.
Endpoint positions and an in-horizon goal-stop position are fixed, but endpoint tangent/yaw is recomputed and therefore gated separately.
The earlier one-snapshot screen applied another smoother to an already strength-10 final trajectory and used a 0.25 m screen corridor; its numerical result is candidate-selection evidence only.

pairing.pairing_method: same ROS header stamp, then first unused causal bag record; timer stop refresh outputs remain unused

production_pipeline.candidate_rejection_behavior: transactional fail-open to the common pre-smoothing geometry; any such rejection fails this preflight
order: resample raw at 0.5 m plus original stations and goal stop station
smooth_trajectory_geometry at 0.25 m with 0.10 m guard

progress_reconstruction.method: first recorded Float32 remaining-distance seed followed by causal header-time odometry replay through RoutePlan.project

validation_boundary.statement: A PASS only unlocks one straight-only CARLA live A/B. It is not 60 km/h qualification or real-vehicle calibration evidence.
